title.narrative: EU Support for Integrated Territorial Development - EU Integra in Serbia

description.narrative:
Targeting 144 local self-governments and Regional Development Agencies across three regions - Šumadija and Western Serbia, Southern and Eastern Serbia, and Vojvodina—the EU INTEGRA focuses on capacity building and technical assistance aligned with EU Cohesion Policy 2021–2027, and support in implementing integrated projects.

The European Union funds the programme, and UNOPS is contracted to build capacities of local, regional and national stakeholders, while the Union of Towns and Municipalities of Serbia manages implementation for the development and implementation of integrated development projects, support through grant scheme and the integration of projects based on territorial strategies with the framework of the planning and budget system.
